newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - LS dead, HS discreet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - LS dead, HS discreet.

text.p: The low sulphur straight run market was very quiet on Monday with only nominal interest shown by buyers.

Firmer crude gave cold comfort to sellers who might have been able to hike prices up but were unable to find potential purchasers. "There's zero interest. Notionally prices are around $144 fob NWE," said one dealer at an oil major.

Russian straight run talk was restricted to M-100 and M-40s since last week's E-4 cargo was thought to have found a home. Offers on the 1-2 percent water M-100 cargoes were at two means +$3 countered by bids of two means +$1.
